oliver (docs): Hey team - small but important mismatch: streaming examples in /v1/stream show SSE payloads with an event field \"delta\" but the runtime sends \"content\". Customers building parsers are getting empty messages. I'll open a docs PR to align examples and add migration notes.
rachel (api): Thanks. We rolled a runtime change last month to standardize on \"content\" to match other endpoints; docs didn't get updated. Server will accept both keys for now, but we should mark \"delta\" as legacy in the docs.
maya (sdk-js): JS SDK streaming helper currently expects `delta` and maps it to the message buffer. I'll update the SDK to accept `content` too and add a small warning when `delta` is present. Can you paste the exact SSE example you want in docs so SDK tests mirror it?
ben (sdk-py): Python SDK uses a low-level event loop that reads raw data and yields chunks; tests assert chunk.data.includes('\"delta\"'). I'll update tests to look for both `delta` and `content`. Also will add a tiny helper to normalize event payloads into {text}.
ci-bot: docs preview linter: streaming.md shows both `delta` and `content` in examples flagged as ambiguous.
oliver (docs): Proposed canonical SSE example for docs (use content):
```bash
# curl SSE example (canonical)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"Write a haiku","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream | sed -n '1,10p'
# sample event payload (each line is a SSE event):
# data: {"type":"progress","content":"Writ"}
# data: {"type":"progress","content":"ing a"}
# data: {"type":"done","content":"haiku\n"}
```
maya (sdk-js): Nice. I'll add tests using that sample payload and update readme streaming snippet to show `event.data.content` parse. Also will add a snippet for backwards compatibility showing how to accept `delta` too: `const text = event.data.content || event.data.delta` in the docs migration note.
ben (sdk-py): For python snippet I'll show normalization: `chunk = json.loads(event.data); text += chunk.get('content') or chunk.get('delta')`. Will include that exact line in docs so users can copy-paste.
rachel (api): When updating OpenAPI, add an examples section in the streaming schema showing both shapes and annotate `delta` with x-deprecated:true. Also update the changelog entry: Streaming event shape clarified to use `content` (legacy `delta` accepted until 4/1/2026).
oliver (docs): I'll: - update streaming.md SSE examples to canonical `content` - add legacy example & migration snippet (`content || delta`) - update API ref streaming schema examples + deprecation callout - add one-line note in migration guide that server accepts both until 2026-04-01. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4242 (WIP).
maya (sdk-js): I'll open SDK PR to accept `content` and keep `delta` mapping. I'll include unit tests with both payloads and a changelog entry. Targeting v1.3.2.
ben (sdk-py): Same for python SDK PR, targeting v0.12.4. Will link PR to docs PR.
ci-bot: docs preview build queued.
deploy-bot: FYI, stream-parser e2e infra currently flaky; recommend we wait on staging e2e before merging.
rachel (api): We'll coordinate a small canary on staging and post traffic results in this thread. Recommend docs merge only after SDK patches land so examples match released clients.
oliver (docs): Agreed. I'll mark PR as blocked until SDK PRs link back. After merge I'll post an announcement in #devex and #support and add a short note in the breaking changes section.
maya (sdk-js): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/888 - includes compatibility mapping + tests.
ben (sdk-py): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/666 - tests added.
ci-bot: docs preview build passed after example update - preview: https://deploy-preview-4242--docs.redwood.ai/ (CI: \u2714)
deploy-bot: staging e2e ran - stream parser flaky test retried and passed.
oliver (docs): Thanks all. I'll remove the WIP tag and merge after linking the SDK PRs in the description. Then I'll send a short note to #product and #support with the recommended quick-fix snippet: `const text = chunk.content || chunk.delta`.
